en.headline: 355 own commits and 60 issues across OpenCode skills and agent tooling
en.teaser: Thirty days of building agent skills and reporting upstream OpenCode bugs: 355 own commits plus 420 automated ones, 9 pull requests and 60 issues.
en.overview:
The window ran 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-22 with data on all 30 days. Grand totals are 355 own commits, 420 additional automated commits, 9 pull requests, 60 issues and 0 reviews. Work split between the user's own skill packages and upstream bug reports against OpenCode clients and skill registries.

### Own skills and tooling

The largest own-repo output went to the profile repository `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where the activity card and daily-report workflow were reworked: copy switched to English, the chart note replaced by a peak/average summary, the daily report moved to a two-hour rolling update with a manual date input, and checkout/setup-node upgraded to v7. The `asset-inventory` skill saw the most releases of any project, iterating from v1.12.0 through v1.14.0 and v1.15.0 with dimension-level rules (dedup exemptions, unparseable-paste branch, Table 2/6 extraction, visible checkpoints), a `🛑broken` state marker, security guards on scanned text, a release-prep script with docs-parity gate, and a registry-first host-command scan.

`meld-deepresearch` went from a first landing page to four releases (v0.1.0 through v0.4.0): an observations evidence type, a bilingual dark/light landing page, a Chinese README, validation scripts and CI, then a split into three cooperating skills (core, spreadsheet analysis, and a third) and a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping the six gate scripts. `opencode-go-model-picker`, `opencode-skill-management` and `opencode-agent-sandbox` completed the agent-skill set, adding failure-mode diagnostics, checkpoint markers, a skill management plugin with list/inspect/disable/enable actions and trusted-publishing CI, and a knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, auth and Windows paths.

### New projects and smaller changes

`sopen-translate` was started from scratch as an MV3 browser extension with a provider protocol layer, presets, glossary pipeline, chunked bilingual page rendering, circuit breaker and progress reporting; selection translation was later dropped. `myBlog` received three OpenChamber screenshot samples. In `opencode-skill-creator` there were no own commits, only 5 automated commits.

### Upstream reports and pull requests

`openchamber/openchamber` absorbed 30 issues and several discussion threads about multi-run process cleanup, context-panel breakdown math, browser capture resolution, stale-save clobbering of AGENTS.md, missing auto-update manifests in v2.0.1 and skipped-role turn merging; many were later closed. Against `anomalyco/opencode`, 12 issues covered MiMo-V2.6-Flash image handling, subagent `model_coming_soon` failures, Windows CLI availability and websearch HTTP 400 responses. Smaller reports went to `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`, `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`, `vercel-labs/skills` and both `OpenSenseNova` repositories. On `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator`, 8 pull requests addressed OpenCode V2 plugin load errors, CRLF frontmatter handling, platform-specific browser commands, eval robustness and dist inlining; all were closed and merged upstream. One pull request added `asset-inventory` to `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills`.

### Data notes

Dates from 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-01 were reconstructed via GitHub Search and are approximate: star counts are unavailable and releases cover only the user's own repositories.

zh.headline: 30 天：355 次本人提交、60 条 issue，围绕 OpenCode 技能与 agent 工具
zh.teaser: 这个月主要在做 agent 技能包，并向 OpenCode 客户端与技能仓库反馈问题：355 次本人提交，另有 420 次自动提交，9 个 PR 和 60 条 issue。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-09-23 至 2026-10-22，30 天均有数据。总计 355 次本人提交，另有 420 次自动提交，9 个 pull request、60 条 issue、0 次 review。工作分为两块：维护自己的技能包，以及向上游 OpenCode 客户端和技能仓库反馈问题。

### 自有技能与工具

自有仓库中提交量最大的是个人主页仓库 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`，重做了活动卡片与日报工作流：文案改为英文，图表说明换成峰值/平均值摘要，日报改为每 2 小时滚动更新并支持手动指定日期，checkout/setup-node 升级到 v7。`asset-inventory` 技能发布次数最多，从 v1.12.0 一路迭代到 v1.14.0 与 v1.15.0，加入了去重豁免规则、无法解析粘贴内容分支、Table 2/6 规则抽取、可见检查点、`🛑broken` 状态标记、对扫描文本的安全约束、带文档一致性校验的发布准备脚本，以及注册表优先的主机命令扫描。

`meld-deepresearch` 从首个落地页发展到四个版本（v0.1.0 至 v0.4.0）：新增 observations 证据类型、双语明暗主题落地页、中文 README、校验脚本与 CI，之后拆成三个协作技能，并用一个轻量 `meld.py` 命令行把六个 gate 脚本包起来。`opencode-go-model-picker`、`opencode-skill-management` 和 `opencode-agent-sandbox` 补齐了技能组合：离线价格种子、双问模式诊断、失败模式处理、技能管理插件（list/inspect/disable/enable）与 trusted publishing，以及记录 OpenCode V2 分发、认证和 Windows 路径坑的知识库。

### 新项目与其他改动

`sopen-translate` 从零搭建为 MV3 浏览器扩展，包含 provider 协议层、预设、术语表流水线、分块双语页面渲染、熔断与进度显示，后续移除了划词翻译。`myBlog` 新增三张 OpenChamber 截图样例。`opencode-skill-creator` 没有本人提交，仅有 5 次自动提交。

### 上游问题与 PR

`openchamber/openchamber` 收到 30 条 issue 和若干讨论帖，涉及多开运行残留 MCP 子进程、上下文面板占比计算、浏览器截图分辨率、AGENTS.md 被覆盖保存、v2.0.1 缺少自动更新清单、跳过角色的回复被合并等，多数后续被关闭。对 `anomalyco/opencode` 提交了 12 条 issue，覆盖 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 图片处理、子代理 `model_coming_soon` 失败、Windows CLI 缺失与 websearch 返回 HTTP 400。另有较小反馈提交到 `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`、`iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`、`vercel-labs/skills` 和两个 `OpenSenseNova` 仓库。在 `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` 提交了 8 个 PR，处理 V2 插件加载失败、CRLF frontmatter、平台相关浏览器命令、评测健壮性与 dist 内联，均已合并关闭。另有 1 个 PR 将 `asset-inventory` 加入 `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills`。

### 数据说明

2026-09-23 至 2026-10-01 的数据经 GitHub Search 回溯重建，属于近似值：星数不可用，release 仅覆盖本人仓库。

highlights.text: 发布 v1.13.0 至 v1.15.0，加入 🛑broken 状态标记、扫描文本安全约束和注册表优先的主机命令扫描。
v0.4.0 引入轻量 meld.py 命令行统一六个 gate 脚本，并上线双语明暗主题落地页。
v0.2.0 发布 skill_management 插件，提供 list、inspect、disable、enable，且只写入一条权限规则。
加固解析、聚合与安装环节的评测健壮性，9 月 28 日提交，后被上游合并。
报告删除多开运行后残留 MCP 子进程，导致 git worktree remove --force 报 Permission denied。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图片输入，但 Go 端点对所有图片返回 400。
提交 PR 将 sogeisetsu/asset-inventory 技能加入清单。
申请将 sogeisetsu/asset-inventory 收录进技能索引。
